name: century-nit-suite
description: Century NIT — web, api and shared packages

scripts.dev: docker compose up -d db redis && npm run dev:api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=century-nit-api
scripts.//build:frontend: century-nit-ops emits into century-nit-web/dist/client/ops, so web MUST build first — its build empties that directory.
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=century-nit-web && npm run build --workspace=century-nit-ops
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build --workspace=century-nit-web && npm run build --workspace=century-nit-ops
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspace=packages/core
scripts.lint: npm run build:packages && npm run lint --workspace=packages/shared --workspace=packages/core --workspace=century-nit-api
